metadata.question: Does forest cover decrease in Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia (east region) from August 1986 to August 2001?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia (east region) - approximately -17.8° S, -63.2° W - Time periods: August 1986 and August 2001 - Collection: Landsat 5 for 1986, Landsat 5 or 7 for 2001 - Need to calculate forest cover using NDVI or use existing forest datasets 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds to get accurate forest cover estimates - Use QA bands for cloud masking - Question is about forest cover change, not clouds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Forest cover legitimately decreased/increased (A/B answer) - C1: No images found for one or both periods - C2: After cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values - Need to check pixel counts and validate results at each step ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Santa Cruz de la Sierra, east region const santaCruz = ee.Geometry.Point([-63.2, -17.8]).buffer(30000); // 30km radius // 2. Define time periods const period1986 = ee.Filter.date('1986-08-01', '1986-08-31'); const period2001 = ee.Filter.date('2001-08-01', '2001-08-31'); // 3. Function to mask clouds in Landsat 5 function maskL5Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } // 4. Function to mask clouds in Landsat 7 function maskL7Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } // 5. Function to calculate NDVI and classify forest (NDVI > 0.6) function addForest(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).rename('NDVI'); const forest = ndvi.gt(0.6).rename('forest'); return image.addBands([ndvi, forest]); } // 6. Get Landsat 5 data for 1986 let col1986 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(santaCruz) .filter(period1986) .map(maskL5Clouds) .map(addForest); const size1986 = col1986.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1986 Images found: ${size1986}`); if (size1986 === 0) { console.log('No data for August 1986'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 7. Get Landsat data for 2001 (try L7 first, then L5) let col2001 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(santaCruz) .filter(period2001) .map(maskL7Clouds) .map(addForest); let size2001 = col2001.size().getInfo(); if (size2001 === 0) { col2001 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(santaCruz) .filter(period2001) .map(maskL5Clouds) .map(addForest); size2001 = col2001.size().getInfo(); } console.log(`2001 Images found: ${size2001}`); if (size2001 === 0) { console.log('No data for August 2001'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 8. Create median composites const img1986 = col1986.median(); const img2001 = col2001.median(); // 9. Calculate forest area for 1986 const forest1986 = img1986.select('forest'); const stats1986 = forest1986.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: santaCruz, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const forestPixels1986 = stats1986['forest_sum']; const totalPixels1986 = stats1986['forest_count']; console.log(`1986 - Forest pixels: ${forestPixels1986}, Total valid: ${totalPixels1986}`); if (totalPixels1986 === 0 || totalPixels1986 === null) { console.log('No valid pixels for 1986 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 10. Calculate forest area for 2001 const forest2001 = img2001.select('forest'); const stats2001 = forest2001.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: santaCruz, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const forestPixels2001 = stats2001['forest_sum']; const totalPixels2001 = stats2001['forest_count']; console.log(`2001 - Forest pixels: ${forestPixels2001}, Total valid: ${totalPixels2001}`); if (totalPixels2001 === 0 || totalPixels2001 === null) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2001 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 11. Validate calculations if (forestPixels1986 === null || forestPixels2001 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null result'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 12. Calculate forest cover percentages const forestCover1986 = (forestPixels1986 / totalPixels1986) * 100; const forestCover2001 = (forestPixels2001 / totalPixels2001) * 100; console.log(`Forest cover 1986: ${forestCover1986.toFixed(2)}%`); console.log(`Forest cover 2001: ${forestCover2001.toFixed(2)}%`); console.log(`Change: ${(forestCover2001 - forestCover1986).toFixed(2)}%`); // 13. Final answer if (forestCover2001 < forestCover1986) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
